title: The fard parts of Salah
intro: The six parts of Salah that must be done for the prayer to be valid.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: O believers, seek help through patience and prayer. <small>(Qur’an, Al-Baqarah 2:153)</small>

Salah is worship done for Allah that is very valuable and needs our full presence. The Prophet (SAW) taught us how to pray, and showed us which parts are essential for the prayer to be valid, and which parts we can make up or correct (with sajdat as-sahw) if we miss them.
The fard parts of Salah must be done for the prayer to be valid. Someone who realises after Salah that they left out a fard must pray it again.

learn.text: The six fard parts of Salah

items: Iftitah takbir – the opening takbir: saying Allaahu akbar quietly while standing, at the start of Salah.
Qiyam – standing, for as long as it takes to recite the required part of the Qur’an.
Qira’ah – reciting the Qur’an: in every rak‘ah we properly recite a set part of the Qur’an.
Ruku‘ – bowing at the waist, at least as far as reaching the knees; in ruku‘ we try to keep the back level with the head.
Sajdah – making two sajdahs, with the forehead, nose, palms, knees and toes on the ground.
Qa‘dah akhirah – the last sitting, after the last rak‘ah, at least as long as it takes to recite At-Tahiyyat; then the salawat, duas and salam.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: We do the fard parts of Salah as our health allows at that moment.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “What do you think – if there were a river at someone’s door and he bathed in it five times a day, would any dirt be left on him?” They said: “No dirt would be left.” He said: “That is like the five prayers, by which Allah wipes away sins.” (Bukhari and Muslim)

questions.q: What are the fard parts of Salah?
options: Parts that must be done for the Salah to be valid

questions.q: How many fard parts of Salah are there?
Is Salah valid if we leave out a fard?
options: No – we must pray it again

questions.q: Which parts touch the ground in sajdah?
options: Forehead, nose, palms, knees and toes

questions.q: How long must the last sitting last?
options: At least as long as At-Tahiyyat takes

questions.q: What are the five prayers like, in the hadith?
options: A river we bathe in five times a day

practice.title: Questions and tasks
prompts: 🧍 With your muallim, practise doing each fard part of Salah correctly.
📖 Read the meaning of Surah Al-Ma‘un and talk about it, especially its last two ayahs.
🖼️ Make a poster of the fard parts of Salah.
